text:
Ana Li: Quick ping — PR #356 (style cleanup: kv cache refactor). Small renames + gofmt. Need one approver to merge before EOD if CI is green. @Kevin @Lia can you glance?

Kevin Wang: On it. I can do a quick pass in ~30m.

CI Bot: build/ci: started for PR 356 — running linters and unit tests

Lia Patel: Skimmed the diff. Two tiny nits: 1) prefer 'kvCache' (camelCase) for the package-level var instead of 'kvcache' to match other files. 2) receiver name in kv_cache.go is 'c' now — prefer 'k' for clarity. Also there's one comment with 'kv cache' (space) — we usually write 'KVCache'.

Ana Li: Thanks — I can fix both. Should I push an amend or open a tiny follow-up PR?

Kevin Wang: Amend is fine. Keeps history clean. Use `git commit --amend` + `git push --force-with-lease`.

Ana Li: Pushed amend (force):
```
commit 2f7e3a4 (amend)
- var kvcache = NewKVCache()
+ var kvCache = NewKVCache()
```
`git push --force-with-lease origin pr/356-amend`

CI Bot: build/ci: updated for PR 356 — re-running checks

CI Bot: build/ci: success — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

Kevin Wang: LGTM. One tiny comment left: in kv_cache.go comment block, change 'KV cache' -> 'KVCache' (we've been removing spaces in type-like names). I can approve if you want me to waive it.

Ana Li: Done, changed the comment and pushed another small amend. Leaving the branch for you to approve.

Kevin Wang: :thumbsup: Approved. Merge window? No release freeze on services owning kv cache.

Lia Patel: Go ahead and merge. No release notes needed for this micro refactor.

Ana Li: Merging now: `gh pr merge 356 --squash --body "style: kv cache naming / gofmt"` Thanks all!

merge-bot: PR 356 merged by Ana Li (squash)
